snippets.snippet: CITY OF SLAUGHTERS MONTHLY BOARD MEETING March 05, 2024 The City of Slaughters Monthly Board Meeting was held Tuesday, March 05, 2024, at 6:00 p.m. at the Slaughters City Hall. Those in attendance were Mayor Chris Winstead, Commissioners Debra Rudd, Mickey Duncan, Kenneth Wells & Matt Johnson, City Clerk Sherri Crowley, & City Attorney Bobby Murray. Quest Rodney Williams Mayor Chris Winstead called the meeting to order at 6:00pm, and Debra Rudd opened with prayer. Copies of the February 06, 2024, minutes were distributed to Board Members. Motion by Kenneth Wells to accept report as read. Second by Debra Rudd. Motion carried. Copies of the February 2024 Financial report were presented to the board. Motion by Mickey Duncan to accept financial report as is. Second by Matthew Johnson. Motion carried. Public Appeals A verbal complaint concerning the zoning ordinance was presented to the Board
